AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
